# Purchase Settings

## When to use this page

Use this screen to review its available records and supported actions.

## Typical tasks

- Follow the documented “Operator steps and checks” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “Screen references” instructions below.
- Follow the documented “List” instructions below.

> Ownership: Purchasing records commercial supplier commitments; Inventory posts physical quantities; Accounting and Payments manage AP and settlement.

## Operator steps and checks

Review purchasing defaults and approval thresholds before creating commitments. Auto-approval applies only when a **positive threshold** matches the PO currency; otherwise the PO follows explicit approval and maker/checker permissions. A settings change affects future evaluation rather than authorizing a historical PO or posting stock. Check settings permissions before changing defaults and confirm the impact in a new Draft submission, not by editing sent orders.
